summary: Verified the bugfix: diagnóstico del 'Ajuste de saldo' ahora muestra la FECHA de la sobreventa por canal. Backend endpoint GET /api/analiticas/conciliacion-diagnostico?gran=todo returns 200 and for canal 'finca' includes sobrevendido_cestas=4.0, sobrevendido_kg=56.0 and sobrevendido_detalle=[{fecha:'2026-09-08', cestas_de_mas:4.0, kg_de_mas:56.0}]. UI: at /dashboard/analiticas, clicking 'Ver de dónde sale este ajuste' opens the diagnóstico; block data-testid='er-diag-fechas-finca' is rendered showing 'Ocurrió el:' and '• 2026-09-08: 4 cesta(s) de más (-56,00 kg)'. Ajustes manuales section, totals, and page load work without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3400+ lines - consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability.
conciliacion_diagnostico correctly excludes VENTA_SYSTEM_ORIGENES and uses date-window filter; algorithm for detalle_fechas is O(n log n) per canal - acceptable for current data volumes.
seed_data_creation: None (used pre-seeded simulated sale in ventas_finca 2026-09-08, 4 cestas, per main agent instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'sobrevendido_detalle' fecha en diagnóstico verified end-to-end. Endpoint returns proper detalle_fechas array; UI renders er-diag-fechas-{canal} block correctly.
